payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to address imbalanced datasets, including data expansion and loss control.

claims.text: Data expansion using oversampling is one method to deal with imbalanced datasets, which includes duplicating texts with low pattern proportions and modifying characters.
Adding loss control in the model helps focus on harder cases in different classes, reducing the impact of imbalanced data.
Different approaches to handle imbalanced datasets were experimented with in the context of a hybrid text normalization system.
